title: 받아쓰기 6: [조타]는 좋다, [식땅]은 식당
objective: Hear [조타], [추카], [식땅] and write 좋다, 축하, 식당.
summary: Write words whose sounds change with ㅎ or after final ㄱ.

task.title: Listen, choose, and write
task.line: Say each word out loud, then pick or write the correct spelling or the real sound.

words.exampleMeaning: The weather is really nice today.
The gimbap at this restaurant is good.

letters.as: ㅎ meets ㄷ, ㄱ, or ㅈ: say strong ㅌ, ㅋ, or ㅊ (좋다 [조타], 넣고 [너코]). The t in ㅌ is like t in 'top'. Still write ㅎ.
ㄱ or ㅂ meets ㅎ: say strong ㅋ or ㅍ (축하 [추카], 급해요 [그패요]). The k in ㅋ is like k in 'kite'.
After final ㄱ, the next ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ, ㅅ, ㅈ turn tense: ㄲ, ㄸ, ㅃ, ㅆ, ㅉ (식당 [식땅], 학생 [학쌩]). Tense ㄸ is close to the t in 'stop'.

exercises: Choose the correct spelling for the sound you hear: ① [차캐요] (차캐요 / 착해요) ② [책쌍] (책쌍 / 책상) ③ [어떠케] (어떻게 / 어떠케)
Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 국밥 ② 넣고 ③ 급해요
Write the correct spelling for the sound you hear: ① [약꾹] ② [노타] ③ [맥쭈]
Fill in the blank with the correct spelling of the sound in [ ]: ① [학쌩] 저는 ____이에요. ② [숙쩨] 오늘 ____를 해요. ③ [마켜요] 오늘 길이 ____.
answers: ① 착해요 ② 책상 ③ 어떻게
① 약국 ② 놓다 ③ 맥주
① 학생 ② 숙제 ③ 막혀요
